lessons: The premise is false: this ticket claims to be the last in the chain, but PENDING still names five files outside the fence: tests/integration/test_retry_keeps_branch.py:20, tests/integration/test_serve_verdict_orphan_sweep.py:39, tests/unit/test_check_meta_fill.py:26 and :65,

Deleting PENDING and its checks (Scope in, criteria 1 and 3) makes the scan fail on those five files. Fixing them would mean edits outside the Scope fence, which Definition of rejected forbids. As written, the ticket cannot pass.

Re-author the ticket in one of two ways. Option 1: add the five files to the Scope fence and Scope in, with their stand-in counts (1, 1, 2, 1, 1). Option 2: file a separate migration ticket for them and list it under ## Depends on.

The run found that the dependency already migrated the nine FakeGit unit files. Check that against main before re-authoring, and keep only the FakeGit/fake_git deletions and the fourth scan pattern if that work is already done.
